invention.ref: Edward Nairne markets rubber erasers in London (noted by Priestley, 15 Apr 1770)
invention.ref_zh: 奈恩在伦敦出售橡胶擦（普里斯特利 1770 年 4 月 15 日记载）

patent.ref: Hymen Lipman's pencil-with-eraser patent US 19,783 (30 Mar 1858)
patent.ref_zh: 李普曼获铅笔加橡皮头专利 US 19,783（1858-03-30）

popularization.ref: Charles Goodyear's vulcanization makes rubber durable
popularization.ref_zh: 固特异发明硫化，使橡胶耐用

notes: 李普曼的专利后来被美国最高法院判定无效（认为只是两种已有物的组合）。橡皮本身先于硫化橡胶出现，1839 年的硫化让它更耐用。
summary_zh: 1770 年伦敦仪器商奈恩开始出售橡胶擦，普里斯特利记下它能擦掉铅笔痕；1858 年李普曼为铅笔加橡皮头申请了专利。
summary_en: London instrument maker Edward Nairne sold rubber erasers in 1770, as Priestley noted; Hymen Lipman patented a pencil with an attached eraser in 1858.
notes_en: Lipman's patent was later invalidated by the US Supreme Court as a mere combination of existing things. Erasers predate vulcanized rubber; Goodyear's 1839 process made them durable.
